handoff: Review #1 F1-F6 are fixed. Every AC and carried item is traced to a test; no story-added skips; unit 1241/0, typecheck green, integration 12/0 and e2e 21/0 on the files touched. Non-blocking: F1 D11 still names the old <last receipt> id once (and R2.3 does, routed to slice 18); F2 a malformed superseded.json is not traced; F3 a sweep error aborts the set-aside; F4 the lint does not scan the assets its name claims; F5 the git_failed refusal is untested; F6 nit: the ulid is sliced out of the name.

findings.title: D11 states two different Check item ids
findings.detail:
D11 says 'One Check item superseded:<story>:<last receipt>' and, later in the same paragraph, 'The Check item's id is per copy, superseded:<story>:<ulid> (review#1 F6)'. .agents/RULES.md:399 (R2.3) also still says <last receipt>. The RULES text is routed to slice 18.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Change the first id in D11 to <ulid>, and add the R2.3 id to slice 18's rule amendments.

findings.title: A malformed superseded.json is no longer traced
findings.detail:
readMeta returns null without the local_file trace event that readLocalJson(..., root) used to write (S2 / BUG-4 diagnostics). The copy is still listed with its holder unknown, so nothing is guessed.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Trace the parse failure, or use a nullable readLocalJson variant.

findings.title: A failed sweep of unrelated leftovers aborts the set-aside
findings.detail:
setAsideRecord and dropLocalRecord call sweepDropped first. Any readdir or rm error other than ENOENT (EACCES, EBUSY) rethrows, so cleaning an unrelated .drop leftover stops the set-aside. In checkout that happens after the take. The act retries on the next tick.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Make the sweep best-effort: catch the error and trace it.

findings.title: The lint scans less than its name says
findings.detail:
files() returns only .ts and the filter keeps /src/, so 'shipped asset' coverage is not real: packages/cli/assets, plugins/ and packages/schema/json are not scanned. All are clean today. The scope is otherwise right: it leaves CHANGELOG.md, RULES.md and the spec history alone.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Add the assets and schema json paths, or drop 'shipped asset' from the test name.

findings.title: The F3 git_failed refusal is untested
findings.detail:
The refusal is placed correctly: before prepareRecord, the set-aside and the claim CAS. Its code is valid and the do_instead names the command to retry. Nothing pins it.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Add a harness test with a git port whose isAncestor throws: expect git_failed and no claim ref.

findings.title: The ulid is recovered by slicing the name
findings.detail:
c.name.slice(c.story.length + 1) is wrong if meta.story differs from the name's prefix. listSuperseded already parses the ulid. Also, a dry prune of a bad rejected.json still appends a trace line (local.ts:91).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Expose the parsed ulid on SupersededRecord.
